description: We are BeatlessFlame, a team passionate about space, robotics, mechanical engineering, physics, and innovation. We aim to explore fire in microgravity and develop creative, science-based solutions. We value teamwork, critical thinking, creativity, and learning. Join us to turn ideas into reality! We welcome members with skills in programming, AI, data analysis, engineering, physics, 3D modeling, scientific research, design, and presentation. All experience levels are welcome!
